mapper.select: SELECT sd.id, sd.dept_code, sd.dept_name FROM sys_role_department srd INNER JOIN sys_department sd ON srd.department_id = sd.id AND sd.deleted = 0 WHERE srd.role_id = #{roleId}

select r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name from sys_user_department sud inner join sys_role_department srd on sud.department_id = srd.department_id inner join role r on r.id = srd.role_id where sud.user_id = #{userId} and r.deleted = 0 and r.status = 1 order by r.sort_order
